title: 🎒 Personal Things & This / That / These / Those
description: Учим личные вещи, множественное число и указательные местоимения this/these - that/those с юмором. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 1: What's in your school bag?
days.description: Учим названия личных вещей и школьных принадлежностей

grammar.title: Personal Things — Vocabulary
grammar.rule:
Вот основные вещи, которые есть у каждого школьника:

📱 smartphone — смартфон
🎧 headphones — наушники
🪪 ID card — пропуск в школу
💳 bus pass — проездной
🔑 key — ключ
💰 wallet — кошелёк
🕶️ sunglasses — солнечные очки
⌚ watch — часы
🔋 power bank — пауэрбанк (зарядка для телефона)
💄 lip balm — гигиеническая помада

🎯 Вопрос: What's in your school bag? — Что у тебя в рюкзаке?
examples: Leo: 'I have got a smartphone, headphones and a power bank. My phone is always at 3%!' 📱🔋
Mia: 'She has got a lip balm, sunglasses and a watch.' 🕶️⌚💄
Sam: 'I have got a wallet... with no money inside. Sad!' 😭💰
grammar.keywords: smartphone, headphones, wallet, watch, power bank, lip balm, school bag

grammar.title: Plurals — Множественное число
grammar.rule:
В английском языке, когда предметов много (больше одного), мы добавляем окончание -s или -es.

📌 Правила:
✅ Большинство слов: +s → phone → phones, pen → pens
✅ Слова на -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -o: +es → bus → buses, watch → watches, box → boxes, tomato → tomatoes
✅ Слова на -y (согласная + y): y → i + es → baby → babies, party → parties
✅ Слова на -f/-fe: f → v + es → leaf → leaves, knife → knives

📌 Исключения (их нужно запомнить!):
• man → men (мужчина → мужчины)
• woman → women (женщина → женщины)
• child → children (ребёнок → дети)
• tooth → teeth (зуб → зубы)
• foot → feet (стопа → стопы)
• mouse → mice (мышь → мыши)
• person → people (человек → люди)

exercises.question: What is the plural of 'watch'? ⌚
exercises.explanation: watch → watches (слова на -ch добавляют -es)

exercises.question: What is the plural of 'child'? 👶
exercises.explanation: child → children (исключение! Запомни!)

exercises.question: One woman, two ___ . 👩👩
exercises.explanation: woman → women (особое исключение)

exercises.question: One man, three ___ . 👨👨👨
exercises.explanation: man → men (особое исключение)

exercises.question: I have two ___ (watch).
exercises.explanation: watch → watches (добавляем -es)

days.title: Day 3: This/These — That/Those
days.description: Учим указательные местоимения: этот, эти, тот, те

grammar.title: This/These — That/Those
grammar.rule:
Указательные местоимения показывают, ГДЕ находится предмет.

📌 this — этот (один предмет, рядом): 'This is my phone.' 📱
📌 these — эти (много предметов, рядом): 'These are my keys.' 🔑🔑
📌 that — тот (один предмет, далеко): 'That is your house over there.' 🏠
📌 those — те (много предметов, далеко): 'Those are your friends across the street.' 👥

🎯 Лайфхак: this/these = здесь (рядом), that/those = там (далеко).
🎯 Мем: 'This is my homework (рядом). That is my motivation (далеко, очень далеко).' 😂
examples: Leo holds his phone: 'This is my smartphone.' 📱
Mia points to her collection: 'These are my key rings.' 🔑🔑
Sam points to the school across the street: 'That is our school.' 🏫
Leo points to some kids far away: 'Those are my friends from class 5B.' 👥
grammar.keywords: this, these, that, those, near, far

exercises.question: You are holding your phone. What do you say? 📱
exercises.explanation: Предмет рядом (в руке) — this!

exercises.question: You see a school across the street. What do you say? 🏫
exercises.explanation: Предмет далеко — that!

exercises.question: ___ are my keys. (рядом, много)
exercises.explanation: These — для предметов рядом во множественном числе

exercises.question: ___ is my pencil. (далеко, один)
exercises.explanation: That — для одного предмета далеко

exercises.question: These is my phone.
exercises.explanation: These для множественного числа, phone — один. Нужно This is my phone.

grammar.title: All together: Things + Plurals + This/These/That/Those
grammar.rule:
Теперь мы можем описывать предметы вокруг нас!

📌 Рядом, один: 'This is my smartphone.' 📱
📌 Рядом, много: 'These are my headphones.' 🎧🎧
📌 Далеко, один: 'That is my house.' 🏠
📌 Далеко, много: 'Those are my friends.' 👥

🎯 Структура: [This/These/That/Those] + [to be] + [предмет(ы)]

🎯 Мем: 'This is my homework (рядом). That is my free time (далеко).' 😂
examples: Leo: 'This is my power bank. My phone thanks me every day.' 🔋📱
Mia: 'These are my sunglasses. I wear them even in November.' 🕶️❄️
Sam: 'That is my lost wallet over there. Finally!' 💰🎉
Leo: 'Those are my report cards from last year. We don't talk about them.' 📋😅
grammar.keywords: this, these, that, those, plurals, personal things

exercises.question: Your smartphone is in your hand. What do you say? 📱
exercises.explanation: Рядом, один предмет — this!

exercises.question: Your friend's house is far away. What do you say? 🏠
exercises.explanation: Далеко, один дом — that!

exercises.question: ___ are my headphones. (рядом, много) 🎧🎧
exercises.explanation: These — для предметов рядом во множественном числе

exercises.question: ___ is my textbook. (далеко, один) 📖
exercises.explanation: That — для одного предмета далеко

exercises.question: Those is my cap.
exercises.explanation: Those для множественного числа, cap — один. Нужно That is my cap.

days.title: Day 5: Practice — All together
days.description: Повторяем всё: вещи, множественное число, this/these/that/those

grammar.title: Revision: Personal things + Plurals + This/These/That/Those
grammar.rule:
Сегодня проверяем себя! 🎯

📌 Личные вещи: smartphone, headphones, wallet, watch, power bank, ID card, bus pass, sunglasses, lip balm
📌 Множественное число: -s, -es, исключения (children, men, women, people, teeth, feet)
📌 Указательные местоимения:
• this — рядом, один
• these — рядом, много
• that — далеко, один
• those — далеко, много

🎯 Вопросы: What's in your bag? Is this your phone? Are those your friends?
examples: This is my phone. These are my headphones. That is my school. Those are my classmates.
Question: 'Is this your wallet?' — 'No, that is my wallet over there.'
Meme: 'This is my bed. These are my blankets. That is my alarm clock. Those are my dreams of sleeping longer.' 😴

exercises.question: What's the plural of 'man'? 👨
exercises.explanation: man → men (исключение!)

exercises.question: What do you say when you point to ONE thing far away? (один предмет далеко) 👉
exercises.explanation: That — для одного предмета далеко. Those — для нескольких предметов.

exercises.question: ___ is my power bank. (рядом, один) 🔋
exercises.explanation: This — для одного предмета рядом

exercises.question: ___ are my friends across the street. (далеко, много) 👥
exercises.explanation: Those — для предметов далеко во множественном числе

exercises.question: I have three ___ (watch).
exercises.explanation: watch → watches (добавляем -es)

exercises.question: These is my keys.
exercises.explanation: These требует глагол are (множественное число)

days.title: Day 6: Reading — Lost and Found Office (Диалог в бюро находок)
days.description: Читаем смешной диалог в школьной комнате потерянных вещей

grammar.title: Reading: Lost and Found
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем диалог в школьной комнате потерянных вещей. Обрати внимание на this/these/that/those и множественное число!
grammar.keywords: reading, lost and found, funny, dialogue

exercises.question: What did Leo lose?
exercises.explanation: Leo says: 'I lost my wallet! It's brown.'
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 LOST AND FOUND OFFICE — THE CHAOS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: School's Lost and Found office. There are boxes FULL of lost items.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Next! What did you lose?

😭 LEO: I lost my wallet! It's brown. This is so sad!

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Brown wallet... Brown wallet... (looks in boxes) Is this your wallet? (holds up a pink sparkly wallet)

😭 LEO: No, that is NOT my wallet. That is someone's grandma's wallet.

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: OK... Is this your wallet? (holds up a wallet with a cartoon cat)

😭 LEO: No! My wallet has... had... 5 euros inside. Maybe 5 euros I will never see again.

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Oh, I see. Wait! These are wallets? (shows a box of wallets)

😭 LEO: Those are not wallets. Those are my hopes and dreams. (cries inside)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Next!

😎 SAM: Hi! I lost my headphones. They are wireless and very expensive.

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Headphones... (looks into a box) Are these your headphones? (holds up bright pink headphones with cat ears)

😎 SAM: Those are... not mine. But they are cool. Can I have them anyway?

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: No, Sam. Those belong to someone else.

😎 SAM: OK... (looks sad) These are my headphones? (points to a box of tangled wires)

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Those are not headphones. Those are spaghetti.

😎 SAM: Why is there spaghetti in the Lost and Found?

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: I don't know, Sam. I don't know.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Next!

😎 MIA: Hi! I lost my sunglasses. They are very cool. I wear them even when it's raining.

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Sunglasses... Is this your glasses? (holds up reading glasses)

😎 MIA: No, those are for old people. My sunglasses are... wait, is that them? (points to a box)

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: These? (holds up a pair of sunglasses) Are these yours?

😎 MIA: Yes! Those are my sunglasses! Thank you!

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Finally! Someone found their thing!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

😭 LEO (still standing there): What about my wallet?

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Oh. Right. (looks in another box) Is this your wallet? (holds up a wallet)

😭 LEO: No, that's a banana peel.

👩‍🏫 Ms. Johnson: Sorry. Maybe tomorrow.

😭 LEO: (writes on a piece of paper) 'This is my wallet. These are my 5 euros. Those were the good times.' ✍️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
